mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answer_evaluation ( answer_id, main_interview_question_id, evaluation_phase, correctness_score, completeness_score, depth_score, clarity_score, practice_score, total_score, level, strengths, missing_points, correction, scoring_point_results, follow_up_recommended, suggested_follow_up, decision_action, retrieval_batch_id, llm_model, prompt_version, evaluation_standard_version, raw_result ) VALUES ( #{answerId}, #{mainInterviewQuestionId}, #{evaluationPhase}, #{correctnessScore}, #{completenessScore}, #{depthScore}, #{clarityScore}, #{practiceScore}, #{totalScore}, #{level}, #{strengths}, #{missingPoints}, #{correction}, #{scoringPointResults}, #{followUpRecommended}, #{suggestedFollowUp}, #{decisionAction}, #{retrievalBatchId}, #{llmModel}, #{promptVersion}, #{evaluationStandardVersion}, #{rawResult} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, answer_id, main_interview_question_id, evaluation_phase, correctness_score, completeness_score, depth_score, clarity_score, practice_score, total_score, level, strengths, missing_points, correction, scoring_point_results, follow_up_recommended, suggested_follow_up, decision_action, retrieval_batch_id, llm_model, prompt_version, evaluation_standard_version, raw_result, created_at FROM answer_evaluation WHERE answer_id = #{answerId}

SELECT ranked.id, ranked.answer_id, ranked.main_interview_question_id, ranked.category, ranked.knowledge_point, ranked.question_content, ranked.evaluation_phase, ranked.correctness_score, ranked.completeness_score, ranked.depth_score, ranked.clarity_score, ranked.practice_score, ranked.total_score, ranked.level, ranked.strengths, ranked.missing_points, ranked.correction, ranked.scoring_point_results, ranked.follow_up_recommended, ranked.suggested_follow_up, ranked.decision_action, ranked.retrieval_batch_id, ranked.llm_model, ranked.prompt_version, ranked.evaluation_standard_version, ranked.raw_result, ranked.created_at FROM ( SELECT ae.id, ae.answer_id, ae.main_interview_question_id, iq.category, iq.knowledge_point, iq.question_content, ae.evaluation_phase, ae.correctness_score, ae.completeness_score, ae.depth_score, ae.clarity_score, ae.practice_score, ae.total_score, ae.level, ae.strengths, ae.missing_points, ae.correction, ae.scoring_point_results, ae.follow_up_recommended, ae.suggested_follow_up, ae.decision_action, ae.retrieval_batch_id, ae.llm_model, ae.prompt_version, ae.evaluation_standard_version, ae.raw_result, ae.created_at, iq.plan_order, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ae.main_interview_question_id ORDER BY CASE ae.evaluation_phase WHEN 'FINAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'INITIAL' THEN 2 END, ae.id DESC ) AS evaluation_priority FROM answer_evaluation ae INNER JOIN interview_question iq ON iq.id = ae.main_interview_question_id WHERE iq.session_id = #{sessionId} AND iq.question_type = 'MAIN' AND ae.evaluation_phase IN ('INITIAL', 'FINAL') ) ranked WHERE ranked.evaluation_priority = 1 ORDER BY ranked.plan_order ASC

SELECT id, answer_id, main_interview_question_id, evaluation_phase, correctness_score, completeness_score, depth_score, clarity_score, practice_score, total_score, level, strengths, missing_points, correction, scoring_point_results, follow_up_recommended, suggested_follow_up, decision_action, retrieval_batch_id, llm_model, prompt_version, evaluation_standard_version, raw_result, created_at FROM answer_evaluation WHERE answer_id IN
#{answerId}
